## About this page

This page is a companion to the [Data Maker](data-maker.qmd) page. It loads the CSV file that page produces (`airport_route_survey.csv`) and prints the entire dataset to the page as a Markdown table.

## Load the data

```{python}
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display, Markdown


survey = pd.read_csv("airport_route_survey.csv", index_col=0)
```

## Display the full dataset

```{python}
#| label: tbl-survey
#| tbl-cap: "Airport route survey responses, all 300 rows."

display(Markdown(survey.rename_axis("Obs #").to_markdown()))
```
